newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA files for 1.59 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA files for 1.59 mln shr offer.

text.p: Coach USA Inc said on Tuesday it has filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of 1.59 million shares on behalf of 19 selling shareholders.
A total of 852,914 shares are being registered that were issued in connection with four acquisitions accounted for as poolings and completed in December 1996 and February 1997, the company said.
An additional 388,279 shares are being registered that were issued in connection with three acquisitions accounted for as poolings and completed in August 1996, Coach USA said.
Coach USA siad the remaining 351,165 shares are owned Ken Kuchin and the estate of Sidney Kuchin in connection with Mr. Kuchin's resignation from the company as previously announced.

In connection with acquisitions completed by the company that are accounted for as poolings, the company has agreed to register and make available for resale up to forty-nine percent of the shares issued to each stockholder of the acquired companies, Coach USA said.
